data.gender_notes: Bernette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Bernard, meaning ‘brave as a bear’. In French, the diminutive -ette is added to create the feminine form Bernette. The name Bernette carries the meaning “Brave as a bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bernette usually hope their child will grow to embody brave as a bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bernette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave as a bear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bernette total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
